top_signals.title: Russia’s Grain Rerouting Falls Short as War Hits Black Sea Ports
top_signals.summary: Russia is responding to Ukraine’s Black Sea attacks by seeking to reroute its grain exports, but so far the efforts are falling short — only about 1/10th of the volumes are being shipped through the key alternative ports, data show.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: Chainalysis beats most Celsius claims, but ‘audit’ lawsuit survives
top_signals.summary: Chainalysis still faces an aiding-and-abetting claim over Celsius’ disputed $3.3 billion audit after a judge dismissed 15 other claims.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Digital asset volatility and institutional crypto positioning changes.

top_signals.title: Policy paper: Treasury Minutes – September 2026
top_signals.summary: Government departments respond to the Public Accounts Committee reports through a Treasury minute.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Central-bank repricing affecting yields, FX, liquidity and equities.

top_signals.title: Turkey Wants Fund Investors to Give Back ‘Excessive’ Profits
top_signals.summary: Turkey has proposed an unusual solution for its fund crisis — investors who reaped massive gains should voluntarily return their money to help other people stuck in frozen funds.
top_signals.why_it_matters: AI and semiconductor developments impacting technology leadership and capex cycles.
